column32: A crack along the upper side. Ist depth was 9mm.
It had two cracks in the middle: 150mm long and 130mm long. It had one resin pocket.
It has the pit in the middle
It had cracks in the compressive side
It had multiple cracks in the compressive side of up to 10mm depth.
Damage can be observed on the compresive side before or after damage is developed in the tensile side. No noise is associated with the compressive but with the tensile damage.
